design: INDIVIDUAL 09: a robust elderly female councillor with strong legs and charcoal-speckled terracotta hide, wide short head with blunt cranial ridges, shoulder-length black tendrils and individual ivory beads. A calf-length dark teal coat with angular bronze fastenings over a purple side-split skirt, many thin rank chains crossing the chest. Holds an upright bronze-framed circular council seal in the left hand and supports it with the right. Broad stable stance.
